name: TabArena
description: With the growing popularity of deep learning and foundation models for tabular data, the need for standardized and reliable benchmarks is higher than ever. However, current benchmarks are static. Their design is not updated even if flaws are discovered, model versions are updated, or new models are released. To address this, we introduce TabArena, the first continuously maintained living tabular benchmarking system. To launch TabArena, we manually curate a representative collection of datasets and well-implemented models, conduct a large-scale benchmarking study to initialize a public leaderboard, and assemble a team of experienced maintainers. Our results highlight the influence of validation method and ensembling of hyperparameter configurations to benchmark models at their full potential. evaluation_method: accuracy/RMSE depending on dataset, with leaderboard ranking based on aggregated benchmark performance
typical_sota_score: varies by dataset; classification accuracy often in the ~80–99% range (dataset-dependent); aggregate leaderboard differences typically within a few percentage points
reputation: A new living benchmark that aims to become a maintained community leaderboard for tabular ML, but it is not yet as established as long-running tabular suites.
notes: Living benchmark with continuously updated datasets/models; scores vary by dataset and validation protocol, and ensembling/time-budget choices can materially affect results.
